core.name: notes.list
core.title: List notes
core.description: Lists or searches Notes with Skills first. query uses the library search: words, quoted phrases, tag:, in:, is:, has:, colour:, before: and after:. Trash appears only when requested by the query. A changed catalogue refuses a continuation with notes_changed. An absent store returns notes_not_configured; a locked encrypted store returns notes_locked.

query.description: The library search. A continuation keeps its original query; omit it or send the same value.

operation_id.description: Optional retry identity scoped to this principal, connection and document. An unchanged mutation replays its original result for 24 hours, even after later edits; its expired identity never executes again. A read replays while its receipt is retained; after 256 later reads it executes afresh. Reusing an identity with changed arguments refuses. Visual observations are fresh. Inspect before starting another operation. Calls without it never replay.

document.description: The document value rapier.open returned. With a connected host it names the workspace and the connection is the authority; without one it is the workspace's whole authority, so keep it private.

core.name: notes.read
core.title: Read a note
core.description: Reads one note's exact text by file, including a note in Trash. version selects a retained event from notes.history; omit it for the current text. A changed note refuses a continuation with notes_changed. Reading a past version does not authorize replacing the current note.

operation_id.description: Optional retry identity scoped to this principal, connection and document. An unchanged mutation replays its original result for 24 hours, even after later edits; its expired identity never executes again. A read replays while its receipt is retained; after 256 later reads it executes afresh. Reusing an identity with changed arguments refuses. Visual observations are fresh. Inspect before starting another operation. Calls without it never replay.

document.description: The document value rapier.open returned. With a connected host it names the workspace and the connection is the authority; without one it is the workspace's whole authority, so keep it private.

core.name: notes.set
core.title: Set note controls
core.description: Changes only the supplied note controls. Returns changed values and their exact previous values. Archive and Trash are reversible through the same tool; no permanent deletion. Tags stay in the Markdown front matter; a tag change is refused with notes_open while the person has the note open. Reminders are app-only and named in the receipt. Skills stays the person's choice.

section.description: A custom section name, created if needed; empty clears the assignment. Skills stays the person's choice.

tags.description: Replaces the note's front-matter tags; an empty list clears them.

at.description: The first occurrence, in Unix milliseconds.

reminder.description: An app reminder, or null to remove it. The receipt names the app; the device manages delivery.

operation_id.description: Optional retry identity scoped to this principal, connection and document. An unchanged mutation replays its original result for 24 hours, even after later edits; its expired identity never executes again. A read replays while its receipt is retained; after 256 later reads it executes afresh. Reusing an identity with changed arguments refuses. Visual observations are fresh. Inspect before starting another operation. Calls without it never replay.

document.description: The document value rapier.open returned. With a connected host it names the workspace and the connection is the authority; without one it is the workspace's whole authority, so keep it private.

core.name: notes.sync
core.title: Sync notes now
core.description: Runs the Notes sync the person has already configured and returns its outcome. A locked vault, missing connection or required sign-in is reported without opening setup or asking for credentials.

operation_id.description: Optional retry identity scoped to this principal, connection and document. An unchanged mutation replays its original result for 24 hours, even after later edits; its expired identity never executes again. A read replays while its receipt is retained; after 256 later reads it executes afresh. Reusing an identity with changed arguments refuses. Visual observations are fresh. Inspect before starting another operation. Calls without it never replay.

document.description: The document value rapier.open returned. With a connected host it names the workspace and the connection is the authority; without one it is the workspace's whole authority, so keep it private.

core.name: notes.propose
core.title: Create or update a note
core.description: Creates a new note immediately when of is omitted. With of, replaces an unchanged note only after this caller has read its complete current text, retaining the previous text in History. Unread, changed or open notes receive a separate proposal for review. The applied receipt states whether the requested change was written immediately.

text.description: The complete Markdown for the new note or replacement.

title.description: A title for a new note or review proposal; direct replacements use text unchanged.

of.description: The listed note to update. Omit to create a new note.

operation_id.description: Optional retry identity scoped to this principal, connection and document. An unchanged mutation replays its original result for 24 hours, even after later edits; its expired identity never executes again. A read replays while its receipt is retained; after 256 later reads it executes afresh. Reusing an identity with changed arguments refuses. Visual observations are fresh. Inspect before starting another operation. Calls without it never replay.

document.description: The document value rapier.open returned. With a connected host it names the workspace and the connection is the authority; without one it is the workspace's whole authority, so keep it private.

file.description: The created or updated note, or the separate proposal file when applied is false.

applied.description: true for an immediate creation or replacement; false when the requested update waits for review.
